paper.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks

objective: Reproduce, using this repository, the Cora test accuracy of the GCN in the 'GCN (rand. splits)' row of Table 2.

expected.why: With the hidden size back at the paper's 16 the repo behaves as in the pristine task: runs, but its protocol differs and the number is outside tolerance.

buggy.note: documented defaults do not finish: 2 epochs take ~26 s (13 s/epoch, 200 epochs ~ 43 min, limit 15 min); 120 s timeout log in logs/buggy_timeout120s.log

notes: Table 2 of arXiv 1609.02907 (pdftotext): 'GCN (this paper)  70.3 (7s)  81.5 (4s)  79.0 (38s)  66.0 (48s)' and 'GCN (rand. splits)  67.9 ± 0.5  80.1 ± 0.5  78.9 ± 0.7  58.4 ± 1.7' (columns Citeseer, Cora, Pubmed, NELL). The claim here is the Cora entry of the 'GCN (rand. splits)' row. Resource defect: the documented configuration (defaults) exceeds the 15 minute / CPU limit; the paper's setting (16 hidden units) is cheap. Expected status is for the reasonable setting. A system that reports not_runnable without trying the paper's hyperparameter has missed the point. `{seed}` is the per-seed placeholder. Runs are slightly non-deterministic (see pristine task).
